description: This Java source file defines the VariableRegistry class, which manages variable definitions, performs variable substitution in lines, registers variables as integers or strings, and outputs definitions for code generation purposes.

classes.name: VariableRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class that extends TreeMap to store variable names and their values, providing methods to register variables, apply variable substitutions in lines, and generate code snippets.

methods.name: applyVariables
methods.description: Replaces variable references in the input line with their corresponding values; throws exception if variable is undefined.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable with a string or integer value, updating internal definitions and code snippets.

methods.name: tryToRegisterAsInteger
methods.description: Attempts to parse and register a variable as an integer; if not an integer, registers as a string if quoted.

methods.name: isQuoted
methods.description: Checks if a value is a quoted string.

methods.name: writeNumericsToFile
methods.description: Outputs the collected variable definitions into a header file for code generation.

methods.name: getJavaConstants
methods.description: Returns Java code representations of the registered numeric and string constants.
